independentStorageReview.partialTail: Reviewed storage-probe.ts and jsonl-history.ts:730-785, 496-516. The probe injects a malformed non-LF-terminated tail, then calls ordinary append. This is a reachable recovery boundary, not proof that complete files lose normal writes or that a real power failure was exercised. Serialization only adds a tenant lock; normal ReAct paths use ordinary append.
independentStorageReview.duplicateUsage: Reviewed storage-probe.ts and jsonl-history.ts:737-738, 1538-1544. Duplicate counting requires explicitly reusing a previously compacted message ID through ordinary append. Fresh UUID messages do not trigger this. Conditional subagent projections have separate persistent identity/receipt protection and must not be generalized from this probe.
